slice.title: Basic task tracking
slice.goal: Build the initial task tracking prototype: list tasks, create tasks, edit task details/status, and search/filter tasks using local JSON mock storage.
acceptance_criteria: User can see a list of tasks with title, status, and due date.
User can create a task with title, description, status, and due date.
User can edit an existing task, including status.
User can search tasks by text and filter tasks by status.
The main screen and interactive controls have stable data-prototype-id anchors linked to scheme elements.
The prototype uses local JSON mock storage and does not require external integrations.
constraints: Use local JSON mock storage from the sample mock plan.
No new dependencies beyond the selected kit.
Do not implement drag-and-drop board columns in this slice.

notes: This scenario intentionally differs from notes-app: it includes an enum-like status field, a due date, and both text search and status filtering.
Use it to check whether test method contracts generalize beyond the original notes demo.
